scripts.build:package: npm run build:profiles --silent && rm -rf packages/js/dist && tsc -p packages/js/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:profiles --silent && rm -rf dist/dev && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.release:check: npm run verify:profiles --silent && npm test && npm run conformance && npm run verify:pack && npm run smoke:pack
scripts.analyze:sanity-check: npm run build:dev --silent && node dist/dev/study/sanity-check/index.js analyze-samples
scripts.analyze:words:sanity-check: npm run build:dev --silent && node dist/dev/study/sanity-check/index.js analyze-words study/sanity-check/data/demo-words.txt
scripts.analyze:ids: npm run build:dev --silent && node dist/dev/study/id-token-usage/index.js run
scripts.analyze:separators: npm run build:dev --silent && node dist/dev/study/separator-effects/index.js run
